text: Imogen - new job @ the council from Mon. ask how 1st wk went next Fri
Afua's puppy arriving Sat!! cockapoo, called Biscuit. she's been puppy-proofing the whole flat

Eamon retiring end of month after 31 yrs @ the depot - longest serving there by miles. leaving do Thurs @ the Crown, 7ish. his wife Lena coming + the grandkids. he wants zero fuss, which means he secretly wants loads. collection going round, think a decent fishing reel. remind me to get a card the day before and get everyone on shift to sign it
Liam - cat Pepper not eating, vet tomorrow am. he's v worried. text him that evening
Eduardo promoted to ops manager. starts new role in a fortnight. wife Ines v proud
call w/ Yuki - starting @ the vets practice next Tues, nervous abt the surgery shifts. wish her luck the night before
Aurelio's leaving drinks cancelled - he's staying on another 3 months now
Lwazi / dog Rolo turned 2 yesterday. had a cake made of liver lol
remind me to ask Emeka how the interview went - it's Weds 10am, msg him afterwards
Alessia - quit @ the bank. going freelance, graphic design. scared but excited
Pieter's last day Fri. team lunch that day, I'm bringing the cake
Lena - hamster died over the wknd. kids gutted. her daughter Isla wants to bury it in the garden Sun
Olivia + Naledi got a rescue greyhound! Juno. picking her up this weekend
Dafydd - first day as head chef @ Pen-y-Bryn Mon. ring him the day after to see how it went
vet for Mango Tues 4.15. pick up flea stuff on way back

Isaac - redundancy meeting Thurs 2pm w/ HR + his boss. really struggling w/ it, not sleeping, says he's been through it once already in 2019 and can't face job hunting again. wife pregnant w/ no. 2 so money worries on top. check in on him that evening, and maybe take him for a pint the weekend after whatever happens
Lars - training to be a dog groomer, course starts next month. loves schnauzers

Antoine & his partner moving to Lyon for her new job - she's starting as a researcher @ the uni there. flights booked for 3rd. leaving party the Sat before @ theirs. they're rehoming the cat Fifi w/ his mum, which he's sad abt. he's not got work sorted yet, looking at teaching English. should send him that contact from the language school
Ravi - parrot Kiwi 40 this yr!! older than him basically. party for the bird?? apparently yes, Sun
Mehmet started @ Ocado last Mon. said 1st wk brutal, nights. don't forget to check how he's getting on next wk
Wiremu - cat Tama had op on her leg Fri, home now, cone of shame. stitches out in 10 days
Anika - promotion to senior nurse!! found out this morning. must send flowers tomorrow

Kai's mum retiring from teaching after 35 yrs, do @ the school next Fri afternoon. Kai giving a speech + he's dreading it, hates public speaking, already on draft 4. his brother Emeka was meant to do it but he's away w/ work. text Kai good luck that morning. she likes gardening, maybe a voucher for the garden centre
Zainab Ahmed - starts @ Reyes & Walsh solicitors Mon wk. trainee contract. remind me to text good luck Sun night
Chiara - new kitten Olive, tiny, sleeps in her slipper. vaccinations next Weds
Bethany's interview @ the zoo got called off - they filled it internally. she's gutted
Kiri hinted she'd love a proper dog bed for Moana - the big memory foam ones. her bday 14th
Yaw - dad retired yesterday!! big family meal Sat. his sister Afua flying in from Accra for it
dentist Thurs 9am. then car MOT the week after
Imogen - how did the council induction go? said it was all fire safety vids lol. her manager Eamon seems nice
Liam - Pepper's bloods came back ok, just a tooth thing. relief
remind me to ask Eduardo abt the new role the week after he starts. also his son Kai's footy trials same wk
Eamon - wife's knee op the day after his leaving do. poor timing. I said I'd drive them that morning
Pieter Murphy - moving on to Brennan Hughes in Dublin. starts 2nd Nov. wants a decent travel mug for the commute, hint hint

Ines - dog Bruno limping since Sun, might be cruciate ligament like last time. vet Mon first thing, x-ray probably. she's been crying abt it, he's 11 now and the op last time was £3k. her son Isaac going w/ her. ring her Mon afternoon to see what they said
Lena + her husband both made redundant same week. awful. she's applying for school admin jobs. maybe send her the one @ Isla's school
Afua - Biscuit chewed through a charger cable already. puppy classes start Tues eve, 6 wks
Naledi - first wk @ the hospital done. loving the ward, hates the parking. sister Zainab also nurse there
need to buy Ravi a card for his retirement, he finishes Fri. sign it Thurs @ work before he goes
Yuki's cat Sushi went missing Weds night. posters up. check w/ her tomorrow if any news
Emeka - got the job!! Lee & Gonzalez, junior architect. starts in a fortnight. drinks Fri to celebrate
Alessia - first freelance client signed. a café rebrand. bday next Sat, wants nice brush pens
Dafydd - head chef thing going ok, 14hr days tho. girlfriend Bethany v fed up. he's doing a taster menu Sat, I'm going w/ Isla
Isaac - took voluntary redundancy in the end. leaving end of Nov. thinking abt retraining as a plumber. don't forget to send him that apprenticeship link

Wiremu & Kiri's puppies due any day - their lab Poppy, first litter. vet thinks 6-8. they're keeping one, rest have homes lined up already. Kiri's taken the wk off to be around for it, Wiremu on nights so v anxious he'll miss it. kids have named them all already lol. message Kiri once they arrive, and ask if we can visit the weekend after
mtg w/ Olivia's boss re handover cancelled, moved to next Weds
remind me to call Mehmet Fri morning, it's his probation review. then ask how it went that eve

Lars - moved in w/ his boyfriend Antoine finally. 2 cats + Lars's dog Bear, total chaos, the cats live on top of the wardrobe now. new place is in Leith, 2nd floor, no lift. housewarming in a fortnight on the Sat. Lars also just got promoted to senior groomer @ the salon so double celebration. they want plants for the flat apparently
Kai - Monday's speech went fine in the end, mum cried. she's off to Portugal the week after
gym Tues/Thurs/Sat this wk. meal prep Sun eve
Chiara - Olive the kitten had her jabs, all fine. Chiara's brother Yaw allergic so no visits for him lol
Anika's new role starts after half term - ward manager on Ivy. her old team doing a leaving lunch Thurs. remind me to chip in for the gift by Weds

Zainab - first wk @ the firm done. said everyone nice but she's drowning in reading, 200 page bundles. supervisor is Mrs Brennan who's terrifying but fair. her dad Mr Ahmed keeps ringing every evening to ask how it's going which is sweet but a lot. first proper client meeting next Tues. remind me to ask her how that went afterwards
Aurelio - staying on, got a raise apparently. still wants to leave by summer though. into bouldering now, goes w/ Lwazi
Eduardo - Ines's mum v ill, they're flying to Valencia tomorrow. he's had to delay the new role start by a wk. message him the day after they land
Bethany - rabbit Clover's first bday Sun. she's doing a little party lol. likes those willow tunnel toys
Imogen - leaving the council already?? got offered something @ the NHS trust. deciding by Fri. her cat Tilly been ill too so lots going on

long call w/ Lwazi - he's been passed over for the team lead job again, Yaw got it. really knocked him. he's thinking about leaving altogether, has an interview @ another agency next Thurs that he hasn't prepped for. his dog's also been poorly. remind me to ring him the day before the interview and check in the weekend after

Olivia - retiring in March!! 62. had her last appraisal yesterday & told them. her husband retiring same time so they're doing a trip to NZ in April, 5 wks. plans to volunteer @ the dogs trust once back. Juno the greyhound has settled in, sleeps 20 hrs a day. Naledi's minding her while they're away
recycling out Weds night. renew passport before Xmas
